title: Infinity Gauntlet
subtitle: The original 1991 event: short core path, optional setup, and the next steps.
intro: You can read Infinity Gauntlet (1991) #1–6 as a complete story. For a fuller entrance, add Silver Surfer’s Return of Thanos and The Thanos Quest before it. Companion issues are optional, and the later Infinity War and Infinity Crusade are sequels—not required chapters of Gauntlet. This is the original comics event, not Infinity (2013), Infinity Wars (2018), the MCU films, or the 2015 Warzones miniseries.

steps.title: The Return of Thanos
steps.why: Introduces the resurrected Thanos and the conflict that leads toward the gauntlet.
steps.match: Choose Rebirth of Thanos or The Return of Thanos Epic for these issues. Rebirth also contains Thanos Quest #1–2, so do not borrow that setup twice. The Return Epic covers a broader #24–38 range.

steps.title: The Thanos Quest
steps.why: The compact account of how Thanos gathers the gems.
steps.match: Rebirth of Thanos includes both Quest issues. The larger Thanos Quest Epic is an alternative also containing Silver Surfer #39–50 and Annual #3; the two collections overlap.

steps.title: Silver Surfer’s final lead-in
steps.why: A longer bridge into the event. Add this if you want more Silver Surfer and Adam Warlock context.
steps.match: These issues are in the same Thanos Quest Epic as the previous step. Rebirth of Thanos alone does not contain this stretch.

steps.title: Infinity Gauntlet: the complete main event
steps.why: The six essential chapters. Read them straight through if you prefer the short path.
steps.match: Use Infinity Gauntlet: Issues #1–6. The Silver Surfer Epic named The Infinity Gauntlet contains companion Surfer issues, not these six core chapters. Infinity Gauntlet: Warzones! is a separate 2015 story.

steps.title: Optional Silver Surfer companion
steps.why: Adds the Surfer’s perspective. This is a parallel branch of the timeline, not a mandatory stage after core #6; consult the linked issue order to interleave it.
steps.match: The Silver Surfer Infinity Gauntlet Epic collects #51–66, so it supplies these tie-ins and also overlaps some aftermath. Its title does not mean it collects Infinity Gauntlet #1–6.

steps.title: Warlock and the post-Gauntlet world
steps.issues: Warlock and the Infinity Watch (1992) #1–6; Silver Surfer (1987) #60–66; Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #36
steps.why: Follow the consequences and the new guardians of the gems after completing the core event.
steps.match: Infinity Gauntlet Aftermath contains these issues plus material from Silver Surfer Annual #5. Silver Surfer #60–66 also appear in the Surfer Infinity Gauntlet Epic; choose according to whether you want the Warlock material.

steps.title: Optional sequels: Infinity War → Infinity Crusade
steps.why: Continue Starlin’s wider trilogy after Gauntlet if you want more. Neither sequel is needed to finish the 1991 story.
steps.match: Read Infinity War first, then Infinity Crusade Vol. 1 (#1–3) and Vol. 2 (#4–6). These are consecutive events/volumes, not alternative editions. Infinity Wars (plural, 2018) is unrelated to this sequence.
